# Human

<https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/human-colon-preview-data-xenium-human-colon-gene-expression-panel-1-standard>

```{r}
human = LoadXenium(
  'data/00_raw_data/Xenium_V1_hColon_Non_diseased_Add_on_FFPE_outs/',
  fov = 'fov')
human_panel = fromJSON('data/00_raw_data/Xenium_V1_hColon_Non_diseased_Add_on_FFPE_outs/gene_panel.json')
human_panel = human_panel$payload$targets$type$data
human_ordered_mapping = data.frame(name = rownames(human[['Xenium']])) %>% 
  left_join(human_panel, by = join_by('name'))
human@assays$Xenium@meta.data$gene_name = human_ordered_mapping$name
human@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id = human_ordered_mapping$id
human = human |> 
  subset(nCount_Xenium > 0)

human = human |> 
  NormalizeData() |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(human))

ElbowPlot(human, ndims = 50)

human = human |> 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:25, return.model = TRUE) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:25)

SaveSeuratRds(human, 'data/01_processed_data/01_human_processed.rds')
```

# Mouse

<https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/fresh-frozen-mouse-colon-with-xenium-multimodal-cell-segmentation-1-standard>

```{r}
mouse = LoadXenium(
  'data/00_raw_data/Xenium_V1_mouse_Colon_FF_outs/',
  fov = 'fov')
mouse_panel = fromJSON('data/00_raw_data/Xenium_V1_mouse_Colon_FF_outs/gene_panel.json')
mouse_panel = mouse_panel$payload$targets$type$data
mouse_ordered_mapping = data.frame(name = rownames(mouse[['Xenium']])) %>% 
  left_join(mouse_panel, by = join_by('name'))
mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$gene_name = mouse_ordered_mapping$name
mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id = mouse_ordered_mapping$id
mouse = mouse |> 
  subset(nCount_Xenium > 0)

mouse = mouse |> 
  NormalizeData() |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(mouse))

ElbowPlot(mouse, ndims = 50)

mouse = mouse |> 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:20)

SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
```

```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
human = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_human_processed.rds')
ImageDimPlot(human, cols = 'white', alpha = 0.6, 
             group.by = NULL, split.by = NULL, 
             axes = TRUE, flip_xy = FALSE)

ImageDimPlot(mouse, cols = 'white', alpha = 0.6, 
             group.by = NULL, split.by = NULL, 
             axes = TRUE, flip_xy = FALSE)
```
